name: argus-desktop
description: Windows desktop host for the Argus autonomous research runtime
author: lbx154

scripts.test:identity: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('.test-out',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --target ES2022 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --outDir .test-out src/main/backendIdentity.ts src/main/backendProcess.ts src/main/backendResilience.ts src/main/loggerSafety.ts src/main/navigation.ts src/main/redaction.ts src/main/releaseIdentity.ts src/main/runner.ts src/main/windowLifecycle.ts src/renderer/ipcRecovery.ts test/backendIdentity.test.ts test/backendProcess.test.ts test/backendResilience.test.ts test/ipcRecovery.test.ts test/loggerSafety.test.ts test/navigation.test.ts test/redaction.test.ts test/releaseIdentity.test.ts test/runner.test.ts test/windowLifecycle.test.ts && node --test .test-out/test/*.test.js && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('.test-out',{recursive:true,force:true})"
scripts.dist: npm run build:web && npm run build:backend && npm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build:web && npm run build:backend && npm run build && electron-builder --win --dir
